_comment: BloodSugarLog (utility shell) screenshot capture - real-use Log / Insights / History states, never Settings/paywall/onboarding. _setup_taps seeds 45 days of readings (four meal contexts, notes, tags), ranges marked as set, Pro + ad-free (no banner / lock overlays) through window.shellLoadState (no reload: the pagehide persist would overwrite a localStorage seed) and defines bsSet(), which sets theme/accent/unit/typed value/context and navigates with UI.tab (the utility shell's navigation; there is no showScreen). Phone 7 + tablet_7 2 + tablet_10 2 = 11 distinct states; headlines in metadata/screenshot_headlines*.json describe exactly these screens.
